name: agent-lock
description: Many agents in one shared git checkout, on one branch, with no branches or PRs. One state file (.git/agent-lock.json) and one native binary: each file an agent edits is claimed until that agent commits it, `agent-lock commit` commits only your own files, sync/push never touch others' uncommitted work, the git shim refuses whole-tree commands while other agents are working, and package-manager shims run installs one at a time.
